abort_and_terminal_contract.action_failure_receipts: typed D1/D3 action and restoration failure receipts bind exact effect/provider all-or-none tuples; a pre-response failure never invents a provider receipt
abort_and_terminal_contract.result_binding: every D1/D3 abort and M00/live FAIL deeply validates its incident/action evidence and exact class/state; safety or restoration failure takes precedence over simultaneous budget overage
abort_and_terminal_contract.forward_effect: no terminal failure authorizes any later forward action

conditional_post_m00_live_client_after_d.budget_requirements: exact per-category calls, combined D2 spend ceiling, D2/live windows, network allowlist, synthetic identity, expected effects, and cleanup contract

ci_release_matrix_contract.canonical_row_rule: every lane command, environment class, logical outcome count, required flag, command digest, and immutable authority reference exactly derives from expected_lane_rows_by_gate; the D3 exact-integration run repeats the full retained matrix including the distinct integration-candidate Node/Chromium PDF smoke, review regressions, Ruff, offline authenticated UI, two distinct clean network-denied builds, zero-remote-font, visual/accessibility, and order dependence. Parsed workflow jobs, required checks, authenticated check-run receipts, and environment receipts form a one-lane-per-check bijection; a caller-selected command, grouped lane, trivial job, retry, or inherited product-head run is forbidden
ci_release_matrix_contract.sealed_evaluator_setup_receipt: every /tmp evaluator job has its own FC01_V13_CI_EVALUATOR_SETUP_RECEIPT_V1 proving an authenticated exact detached evidence-control worktree, git-show staging from the exact sealed payload, activation/seal binding, byte equality, distinct candidate/control roots, exact workflow run-attempt/job/check/command identity, pre-command environment identity, and zero raw-network fallback
ci_release_matrix_contract.typed_lane_input_receipt: every --validate-ci-lane job loads its exact pre-run FC01_V13_CI_LANE_INPUT_RECEIPT_V1 and deeply validates the gate/lane-specific ordered evidence contracts against the exact candidate. D3 pre-CI inputs bind lineage/source/import/test/baseline/ledger receipts directly and never reference the post-CI d3_integration_candidate, preventing an immutable digest cycle
ci_release_matrix_contract.typed_check_and_environment_receipts: every required lane has one provider-authenticated FC01_V13_CI_CHECK_RUN_RECEIPT_V1 at attempt 1 and one FC01_V13_CI_LANE_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_V1. Candidate/workflow/run/job/check/command/head/tree and exact class profile all cross-bind; clean build slots use distinct jobs, checks, and clean-workspace digests
ci_release_matrix_contract.single_exhaustive_workflow_run_receipt: each gate has exactly one FC01_V13_CI_WORKFLOW_RUN_RECEIPT_V1 at attempt 1 whose authenticated enumeration contains the complete required one-lane-per-job set, matching candidate/workflow run count one, prior matching run count zero, and other matching attempt count zero. Successful lanes cannot be cherry-picked across partial or fresh attempt-1 runs
ci_release_matrix_contract.inherited_live_result_rule: the D3 post-m00-20 lane reuses the singleton nineteen-selector PASS receipt and never reruns it; only the separate Node smoke executes on the integration candidate

clock_contract.engineering_started_at_rule: a typed clean frozen-base worktree plus local-and-origin branch-absence observation is committed first; the singleton engineering-start receipt binds it on activated control history; exact local and origin branch creation at the unchanged base is then sealed by a typed creation receipt before every scoped product/test/CI mutation
clock_contract.pause_start_rule: committed validated packet presentation stop receipt
clock_contract.pause_end_rule: earliest valid decision, rejection, withdrawal, packet expiry, or absolute mission expiry
clock_contract.active_elapsed_rule: preterminal accounting uses wall(engineering_started_at,evaluated_at) minus the exact union of typed pause intervals; final accounting requires evaluated_at>=terminal_at and uses wall(engineering_started_at,terminal_at) minus that union
clock_contract.ledger_chain_rule: every ledger binds the effective seal and exact latest predecessor with monotonic elapsed/remaining and pause-prefix history; only the first preterminal ledger or mission-absolute-expiry-before-engineering branch has an exact null predecessor convention
clock_contract.terminal_at_rule: terminal_at, terminal_state, and terminal_outcome_ref are JSON null for every packet/preaction/consumption and preterminal ledger; nonnull only in the unique direct-child final accounting ledger when the closed canonical D1 abort, M00 fail, live fail, D3 abort/pass, or clock-exhaustion dispatch deeply validates, terminal_at equals that receipt's created_at, and terminal_state equals its exact mapped state field
clock_contract.clock_exhaustion_terminal_rule: active-engineering limit, mission absolute expiry, or packet/approval-window expiry before another typed terminal outcome seals one FC01_CLOCK_EXHAUSTION_TERMINAL_V1 with recomputed first boundary and BLOCKED_BUDGET. The pre-engineering absolute-expiry branch uses the exact null start/ledger convention and active elapsed zero. After any governed action starts, its gate result—not a standalone clock terminal—retains clock overrun plus required safety closure under abort precedence. No forward action follows a standalone clock terminal and a new exact amendment is required
clock_contract.gate_window_rule: window starts_at >= consumption time; ends_at > starts_at and <= packet/absolute expiry; (ends_at-consumed_at) fits strictly within active_remaining_seconds. Every forward test/provider/product action occurs inside the window and both clock ceilings. Immutable terminal evidence and only already-bound rollback, mutation reversal, or cleanup needed to restore safety may occur afterward without authorizing forward work.
